  Geographical Digital Systems, commonly known as Geographic Information Systems (GIS), represent a sophisticated integration of
  computer technology, spatial data, and analytical tools designed to capture, store, manipulate, and visualize information related to
  locations on Earth. Unlike traditional paper maps, which provide only static representations of terrain and features, digital geographical
  systems process data in layers, allowing users to overlay different types of information—such as topography, population density, climate
  patterns, and infrastructure—within a single digital framework. This capability transforms raw geographic data into meaningful insights,
  enabling the transformation of abstract coordinates into practical, understandable visual formats. By combining satellite imagery, global
  positioning technology, and digital databases, these systems have fundamentally changed how humans perceive and interact with their
  physical environment, turning location from a simple reference into a dynamic variable that influences decision-making across multiple
  fields.
  The applications of geographical digital systems extend far beyond simple mapping, playing a critical role in sectors ranging from urban
  planning and environmental management to disaster response and business logistics. In urban development, city planners use GIS to
  analyse traffic flow, allocate resources efficiently, and design sustainable infrastructure that meets the needs of growing populations. In
  environmental science, these systems help monitor changes in land use, track deforestation, and model the impact of climate change on
  different regions, providing essential data for conservation efforts. Furthermore, during natural disasters such as earthquakes or floods,
  digital geographical tools allow authorities to assess affected areas quickly, coordinate rescue operations, and plan recovery strategies with
  greater precision. In the private sector, companies rely on similar technologies to optimise supply chains, locate new markets, and
  understand consumer distribution patterns, demonstrating the versatility and economic value of this technology.
  Looking ahead, the evolution of geographical digital systems continues to accelerate, driven by advances in artificial intelligence, big data
  analytics, and the Internet of Things (IoT). Modern systems are no longer limited to two-dimensional maps; they now incorporate three-
  dimensional modelling and real-time data streaming, which offers unprecedented accuracy and detail. The integration of cloud computing
  has also made these tools more accessible, allowing individuals and organisations to access powerful geographic analysis capabilities
  without needing expensive local hardware. However, the increasing complexity of these systems also raises important considerations

regarding data privacy, accuracy, and the ethical use of spatial information. As these technologies become more integrated into daily life,
they will remain a cornerstone of modern society, bridging the gap between physical geography and digital innovation while helping to
solve some of the world’s most pressing spatial challenges.

pertanyaan: Pak Aidil meninjau catatan pemakaian data sampai hari ke-10 beserta pilihan paket tambahan yang tersedia. Berikan tanda centang (✓) pada setiap pernyataan yang benar.
opsi: Sisa kuota modem pada akhir hari ke-10 adalah 70 GB.
Apabila pemakaian sejak hari ke-11 konstan 3,5 GB per hari, kuota akan habis sebelum masa aktif berakhir.
Harga rata-rata per GB pada paket Plus 12 GB lebih murah daripada pada paket Hemat 5 GB.
pembahasan: (1) Sepuluh hari pertama terpakai 10 × 5 = 50 GB, sisa 120 − 50 = 70 GB → BENAR. (2) Sisa 20 hari × 3,5 GB = 70 GB, tepat habis pada akhir hari ke-30, bukan sebelum masa aktif berakhir → SALAH. (3) Paket Plus: 45.000 ÷ 12 = Rp3.750/GB; paket Hemat: 20.000 ÷ 5 = Rp4.000/GB → BENAR.
Agar tersisa minimal 10 GB, pemakaian hari ke-11 s.d. ke-30 paling banyak 70 − 10 = 60 GB selama 20 hari. Rata-rata maksimum = 60 ÷ 20 = 3,0 GB per hari.
Total 15 hari = 15 × 4 = 60 GB, sedangkan 10 hari pertama sudah 50 GB. Sisa 10 GB dibagi 5 hari = 2,0 GB per hari.

Bandingkan seluruh kombinasi yang mencapai minimal 60 GB. Lima paket Plus tepat 60 GB seharga 5 × 45.000 = Rp225.000.  Alternatif   lain  lebih  mahal:  12  Hemat  = Rp240.000; 4 Plus + 3 Hemat = Rp240.000; 3 Plus + 5 Hemat = Rp235.000.

pertanyaan: Rasio konversi toko didefinisikan sebagai persentase banyaknya pembeli terhadap seluruh pengunjung situs pada periode yang sama. Berdasarkan data pekan tersebut, berikan tanda centang ( ✓ ) pada setiap pernyataan yang benar.
opsi: Rasio konversi toko daring tersebut pada pekan itu lebih dari 5%
Banyaknya pengunjung yang mengklik halaman produk pada pekan itu adalah 3.000 orang.
Total nilai transaksi seluruh pembeli pada pekan itu adalah Rp90.000.000,00.
pembahasan: Pengunjung yang mengklik = 25% × 12.000 = 3.000 orang; pembeli = 20% × 3.000 = 600 orang. (1) Rasio konversi = 600 ÷ 12.000 = tepat 5%, bukan lebih dari 5% → SALAH. (2) 3.000 orang → BENAR. (3) 600 × Rp150.000 = Rp90.000.000 → BENAR.

Misal terjadi x kali penurunan Rp5.000. Pendapatan R(x) = (150.000 − 5.000x)(600 + 60x). Fungsi kuadrat ini bernilai nol pada x = 30 dan x = −10, sehingga maksimum pada x = 10. Harga  Rp100.000  dengan  1.200  pembeli  menghasilkan Rp120.000.000.
Pekan pertama: 600 × 150.000 = Rp90.000.000. Pekan kedua: 150 × 100.000 = Rp15.000.000. Rata-rata gabungan = 105.000.000 ÷ 750 = Rp140.000,00 per pembeli.

Tiap tribun samping: S16 = 8(2·20 + 15·4) = 8(100) = 800 kursi, dua tribun = 1.600. Kapasitas stadion = 2.400 + 1.600 = 4.000. Target 85% = 3.400 penonton. Dari tribun utama harus terjual 3.400 − 1.600 = 1.800 kursi, yaitu 1.800/2.400 = 75%.
Total penonton lima laga = 5 × 2.680 = 13.400. Ditambah final 3.520 menjadi 16.920 untuk 6 laga. Rata-rata = 16.920 ÷ 6 = 2.820 orang.
Sepuluh baris terbelakang adalah baris ke-16 sampai ke-25.

Penurunan = 3.200 − 2.560 = 640 kg CO₂e. Persentase = 640 ÷ 3.200 × 100% = 20%.

pertanyaan: Sekolah menyelenggarakan program klinik belajar sehingga jumlah hari aktif belajar pada suatu bulan bertambah 5 hari. Berikan tanda centang ( ✓ ) pada setiap pernyataan yang benar.
opsi: Tambahan pemakaian listrik akibat penambahan hari tersebut adalah 600 kWh.
Tambahan emisi karbon dari listrik PLN akibat penambahan hari tersebut adalah 480 kg CO₂e.
Tambahan biaya listrik akibat penambahan hari tersebut kurang dari Rp 800.000,00.
pembahasan: Penambahan 5 hari aktif menambah 5 × 120 = 600 kWh. (1) Tambahan pemakaian 600 kWh → BENAR. (2) Tambahan emisi = 600 × 0,8 = 480 kg CO₂e → BENAR. (3) Tambahan biaya = 600 × Rp1.450 = Rp870.000, jadi tidak kurang dari Rp800.000 → SALAH.
